book.name: 1 Korintofɔ
book.title: Ɔwʋlʋ́ Gyankpapʋá Paulo Lɔ́wanlɩ́n Sɩ́sɩ́ Korintofɔ

content: Ɩkpɩsúm Ɩwɩ Ɔláda
Mɩ́ apíó, ndekléá mlɩbɩ́ɩ tɔ́á Bulu lɔ́bwɛ há anɩ anáin amʋ fɛ́ɛ́ bɩ́mbɩ́ ámʋ. Ɔlɛha agyinde lobun amʋ́ fɛ́ɛ́sʋ́, ɔlɛha ɔpʋ pɛpɛ bʋnkpatɔ lɛ́sɛ, ɔlɛkpa amʋ́ fɛ́ɛ́ tsʋn ɔpʋ amʋtɔ.
Bulu lɔ́pʋ agyinde mʋ́a ɔpʋ amʋ bɔ́ amʋ́ fɛ́ɛ́ asú, pʋ́súná ánɩ́ bʋgyi Mose abúopʋ.
Amʋ́ fɛ́ɛ́ begyi ɔŋɛ́tɔ́ atogyihɛ oloku ɔkʋlɛ amʋ.
Bonu ɔŋɛ́tɔ́ ntsu oloku ɔkʋlɛ amʋ tsú bʋtá ámʋ́ʋ́ ɩlɛkpa amʋ́ ámʋtɔ. Kristo gyí bʋtá ámʋ nɩ.
Támɛ ɩ́nɩ fɛ́ɛ́ ɔma a, Bulu ansɩ́ megyi amʋ́ ɔdʋdʋɔ ɩwɩ, ɔlɛhɩ amʋ́ dimbí ámʋsʋ ɩnʋ.
Ntobí ánfɩ ɩlɛba amʋ́sʋ́ ánfɩ fɛ́ɛ́ igyi atosuánhɛ há anɩ, mɛ́nɩ amʋ́ lalahɛ amʋ odu bwɛ mɛ́ɛdɩnká anɩ ɔwɔ́lɩ,
ánɩmóosúm ɩkpɩ ɛ́ fɛ́ amʋ́. Tsúfɛ́ Bulu asʋn wanlɩ́nhɛ́ amʋ ɩlɛblɩ́ ɔbɛ́ɛ, “Ahá ámʋ betsiá asɩ gyí atɔ́, nu ntá, kʋ́sʋ́ kɔ́m.”
Mlɩmáwa atsɩ mʋ́a ayin asʋ́n fɛ́ alɩá amʋ́tɔ́ akʋ bɔbwɛ, ɩlɛha amʋ́tɔ́ mpɩ́m adʋanyɔ-sa (23,000) benya lowu ɛkɛwʋ́lɛ.
Mlɩmáha asɔ Kristo kɩ fɛ́ alɩ ámʋ́ʋ́ amʋ́tɔ́ akʋ bɔbwɛ, awɔ bodundun amʋ́ mɔ́ ámʋ.
Mlɩmálɛ Bulu ɩlá fɛ́ alɩá amʋ́tɔ́ akʋ bɔbwɛ, Bulu lɔ́pʋ ɔbɔpʋ sɩ́sɩ́, ɔlɔbɔmɔ amʋ́.
Ntobí ánfɩ ɩ́lɛba amʋ́sʋ́ fɛ́ɛ́ igyi atosuánhɛ há anɩ. Bɔwanlɩ́n mʋ́ tswɩ, pʋ́dá anɩ ahá ánfɩ ɔyɩ́ ɔnɔ́mɔbɩ́ latʋ́ anɩ ánfɩ ɔlá.
Mʋ́ sʋ nɩ́ fʋkɩ fɛɛ fʋlɩɩ́ kínkíínkín Kristo hógyitɔ á, kɩ wankláán, mɛ́nɩ fʋmɛ́ɛdɩda.

Bɩ ánɩ́ fʋ́ ɩsɔ́kɩ amʋ mɔtsʋn ɔtsan há aha tráhɛ klɛ́. Ɔnɔkwalɩpʋ Bulu gyí. Ɔmɛ́ɛha ɩsɔ́kɩá ɩdʋn fʋ ɩba fʋsʋ. Támɛ nɩ́ fowíé ɩsɔ́kɩtɔ á, Bulu obósuná fʋ́ ɔkpa ánɩ́ fɔ́tsʋn mʋ́sʋ́ tálɩ́ lɩ́ɩ́ mʋ́ ɔnɔ́, mɛ́nɩ fɛ́dalɩ mʋ́tɔ́.
Mʋ́ sʋ apíó adwɛpʋ́, mlɩmáwa ɩwɩ ɩkpɩsúmtɔ́ ɛkɛkɛɛkɛ.
Atɩansɩpʋ mlɩgyí. Mʋ́ sʋ mlɩ onutó mlɩyɔ asʋ́n ánfɩtɔ amlɩkɩ.

Nɩ́ adá Bulu ɩpán, anu anɩ Wíe Yesu ɔpʋ́nʋ́asɩ ɛwɛ ámʋtɔ ntá á, imosuná ánɩ́ anɩa Kristo obugya labwɛ́ kʋlɛ? Nɩ́ abíá bodobodo amʋ ɛ́ ye aba á, mʋ́ ɛ́ imosuná ánɩ́ anɩa mʋ ɔyʋlʋ́ʋ labwɛ́ kʋlɛ?
Ɩ́nɩá anɩ tsɔ́ ó á, bodobodo ipin kʋlɛ anɩtegyi. Mʋ́ sʋ anɩ fɛ́ɛ́ anɩlabwɛ́ ɔyʋlʋ́ʋ kʋlɛ fɛ́ bodobodo ipín ámʋ.
Mlɩpʋkɩ Israelfɔ, megyí ahá ámʋ́ʋ́ bʋtegyi afɔdɩɛ-atɔ́ ámʋ tɔ́bwɛ́ kʋlɛ afɔdɩɛ ámʋ bɔtɔ́?
Mʋ́ sʋ nkálɩ mɩ́ asʋ́n ánfɩ desuná? Blɩ́ ndɛblɩ́ mbɛ́ɛ, ɩkpɩ ntɛ́ɛ atogyihɛ amʋ́ʋ́ bapʋ́há amʋ́ igyí amʋ ɩbʋ labi?
Ɛkɛkɛɛkɛ! Tɔ́á ndɛblɩ́ gyí, nɩ́ akpɩpʋ́ bɛhá ɩkpɩ igyí a, ɔŋɛ laláhɛ bɔpʋhá, megyí Bulu. Mʋ́ sʋ mmedékléá mlɩa ɔŋɛ laláhɛ mlɔ́bwɛ kʋlɛ.
Mlɩmɛ́ɛtalɩ́ pʋ́ anɩ Wíe ɛwɛ tin ɔnɔ́, láyɔ́pʋ ɔŋɛ laláhɛ ɛwɛ ɛ́ tin ɔnɔ́. Mlɩa Kristo mlɩmɛ́ɛtalɩ́ wá ɩbɩ gyi atɔ́, mlɩa ɔŋɛ laláhɛ ɛ́ amlɩwa ɩbɩ gyi atɔ́.
Nɩ́ abwɛ́ mʋ́ alɩ á, anɩmɔ́ɔwa Bulu ɔblɔ́ fɛ́ Israelfɔ? Ntɛ́ɛ anɩkɩ́á anɩbʋ ɔwʋnlɩ́n dʋn Bulu?
Ahá bʋtɛblɩ́ bɛɛ, “Anɩbʋ ɔkpa bwɛ́ tógyítɔ́.” Ɩbʋ mʋ́tɔ́ alɩ, támɛ megyí mʋ́ fɛ́ɛ́ bʋ labi. Fʋdɛblɩ́ fɛɛ, “Anɩbʋ ɔkpa bwɛ́ tógyítɔ́.” Támɛ megyí mʋ́ fɛ́ɛ́ tɔ́bʋ́a anɩ.
Mlɩmákɩ mlɩ nkʋlɛ klɛ́, mboún mlɩkɩ mlɩ aba ɛ́ klɛ́.
Tɔ́á mlɩbwɛ́ɛ gyí, mlɩwɩ ibíásʋ́ iye kugyíkʋ. Mlɩmáfɩtɛ́ mʋ́ ɩwɩ asʋansʋ, mlɩ klʋn ɛ́ ɩmáha mlɩ pɔ́n.
Tsúfɛ́ bɔwanlɩ́n wá Bulu asʋ́n ámʋtɔ bɛɛ, “Bulu bʋ́ ɔyɩ́ mʋ́a mʋ́tɔ́ atɔ́ fɛ́ɛ́.”
Nɩ́ ɔmátɔ́yín ɔtɩ́ fʋ́ atɔ́ ogyíkpá, iletsiá fʋ́ á, fayɔ́. Támɛ nɩ́ fɔyɔ́ á, máfɩtɛ́ mʋ́ ɩwɩ asʋansʋ, fʋ́ klʋn ɛ́ ɩmáha fʋ́ ɩpɔ́n.
Támɛ nɩ́ ɔkʋ ɔbláa fʋ ɔbɛ́ɛ, “Ɔkpɩtɔ-atɔ́ igyi” á, alɩá ɩmɛ́ɛhan ɔhá ámʋ sʋ mágyi atɔ́ ámʋ.
Megyí alɩá ɩbɛ́han fʋ sʋ, mboún ɔhá ámʋ sʋ. Mʋ́ʋ́ ntogyi sʋ́ tɔ́á ɔkʋ désusúu ibétin mɩ́ ɩwɩgyí ɔkpa?
Nɩ́ ntɛdá Bulu ɩpán atogyihɛsʋ asa ntegyi mʋ́ á, ntogyi sʋ́ ɔkʋ ɔbɛ́lɛ mɩ́ ɩlá atɔ́ ámʋ sʋ?
Mʋ́ sʋ nɩ́ fʋdegyí o, fʋdenúu o, bwɛ mʋ́ fɛ́ɛ́ pʋwa Bulu numnyam.
Mlɩmáha mlɩ tsiátɔ́ itin Yudafɔ pʋ́ Griikifɔ ntɛ́ɛ Bulu ɔpasua ámʋ Kristo wá ba ɔkpa.
Ntamakle mɩ́ nkʋlɛ yilé. Tógyítɔ́á ntɔbwɛ́ á, ntɔbɔ́ mbɔ́dɩ́ ánɩ́ nɛ́ha ahá ansɩ́ bégyi amʋ́, mɛ́nɩ Kristo ɔbɔ́hɔ amʋ́ nkpa.
